scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@exile-companion/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@exile-companion/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@exile-companion/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@exile-companion/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/web && npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@exile-companion/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@exile-companion/web && npm run test --workspace=@exile-companion/api
